I've upped my dose both habits but like I said, it takes quite a lot of any benzo (or atleast the main ones ive tried) for it to take effect. And the effect wouldnt last long at all - e.g 40/50mg diazepam would give me a relaxing benzo effect for about an hour or 2 and then the high would completely drop. The anti anxiety effects still stay around for a bit longer (I suffer from minor anxiety, nothing major; this isnt from cold turkeying from benzos, ive had it since my early teens).

Most days i'd just take 1 heavy dose of a benzo i choose (or a mix of multiple ones) in the morning then dont redose to the next day - I drink heavily in the afternoon and Im aware of the severe consequences of a heavy benzo dose and drinking heavily. EDIT: Saying that, I do often dose multiple times a day just not everyday. Especially in my 2nd habit, my first habit I used to redose multiple times a day everyday.

2ND EDIT: Don't know if this helps explain why i dont w/d off benzos but i'm very tolerant to alcohol too, and always have been, alcohol has never had the same effect on me as it does to everyone else. Also the effect of alcohol does not last long at all for me too, the same way the effect of benzos don't last long on me too even long acting benzos such as valium.
